newsitem.title: USA: Fed fines Asahi Bank U.S. branch $5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Fed fines Asahi Bank U.S. branch $5 mln.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said on Thursday that it had fined Asahi Bank Ltd of Tokyo and its New York branch $5 million for misconduct.
The Fed and the New York State Banking Department also jointly issued a cease and desist order against the bank.

The Fed said the orders and the fine were for "misconduct by certain officers of the New York branch relating to the alleged misuse of cofidential supervisory information, to the making of allegedly false statements to bank supervisory officials, and to the alleged obstruction of a formal investigation by bank supervisory officials."
The Fed said that Asahi did not admit to any of the allegations made against them but it signed an agreement to abide by the orders.
Asahi also agreed to train all its U.S.-based personnel "in ethics and the United States bank supervisory process," the Fed said.

The training is to include "the necessity for candor in all communications with bank supervisors, especially during bank examinations" as well as the sanctions possible for failing to comply with the law.
